A '''Sith Lord'''<ref name="Codex" /> of [[Human/Legends|Human]] or [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith pureblood]] descent<ref name="Species" /> of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] was a member of the [[Order of Revan]], a secret society on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] devoted to the teachings of the former [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]],<ref name="Codex" /> several [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] before the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the Empire and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="Time" /> When the Order was forced to stop meeting in the Imperial [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Kaas City]] for fear of retribution, the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] offered the use of the Sith's [[Unidentified Revanite Sith Lord's compound|compound]] as a shelter. However, the Sith was soon [[Assassin/Legends|assassinated]], which forced the Order to retreat deeper into the jungles of Dromund Kaas.<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Revanite Sith Lord was mentioned in the Codex entry for the Revanite Compound in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]]. However, the entry was not made accessible in the final release of the game until [[2016]].<ref name="Codex" />
